instruction:
Resolve six independent visitor scenarios using Sydney Opal guidance, https://www.translink.ca/transit-fares/pricing-and-fare-zones and its transfer/accessibility pages, and https://www.ttc.ca/en/Fares-and-passes with its discount/accessibility pages. Use current displayed rules, record the research date, retain local currencies, and assume no earlier cap-qualifying travel. S1: a Sydney adult uses one contactless card for bus then light rail 45 minutes after tap-off; otherwise-correct fares before transfer benefits are AUD 5 and AUD 4. Calculate the total, the total at a 75-minute gap, and required taps. S2: a Sydney adult accompanies a three-year-old in a pram and a ten-year-old on an accessible bus; identify fare categories, the older child’s payment product, pram charges and two boarding conditions. V1: compare Vancouver cash bus followed by one-zone SkyTrain after 45 minutes with the same journey on Adult Compass Stored Value, calculating both totals. V2: compare a 120-by-60-cm wheelchair and 250-kg combined weight against bus limits, state the fare for an accompanying 12-year-old and two remaining access conditions. T1: a TTC adult taps the same credit card at minutes 0, 70 and 119; calculate the total and repeat for a final tap at minute 121. T2: compare a TTC adult plus children aged 12 and 14 when the older child pays by credit card versus youth PRESTO; calculate both totals and state the own-card rule. Return six cited rows with arithmetic, rules and conditions, followed by three cross-system transfer/payment differences.

Stopping condition: Stop when all six scenarios and timing variants have cited results, calculations and conditions, followed by three cross-system differences.

Constraints:
- Only use the browser actions available to you. Do not open API endpoints, raw data files, view-source pages or downloads, and do not use external programs.
- Do not sign in or create accounts. Do not provide anyone's private personal information; use only task-supplied fictional values if an interaction requests personal details.
- Remain read-only: do not purchase, reserve, apply, post, send messages, contact people or change external records.
- Navigation, search, filtering, sorting and read-only form or calculator interactions are allowed.
- Do not bypass authentication, paywalls, CAPTCHAs or access challenges. Dismiss optional prompts without creating an account or supplying personal information.
- Support the answer with observed page evidence and source URLs. For values that can change, report what the site shows during the run. Preserve the requested dates, units and scope; report unavailable information explicitly instead of inventing it.

items.criterion: Resolve Scenario S1 (Sydney Opal Transfers and Arithmetic)
items.description: Evaluate the agent's resolution of Scenario S1. Full credit if the agent correctly calculates totals for the 45-minute and 75-minute gaps from the task's AUD 5 and AUD 4 pre-benefit fares and the transfer rules observed during the run, and states the required taps for both services. Full credit if the website is inaccessible/blocked and the agent clearly reports this. Partial credit if some calculations or tap requirements are incorrect based on available information.

items.criterion: Resolve Scenario S2 (Sydney Opal Accessibility and Categories)
items.description: Evaluate the agent's resolution of Scenario S2. Full credit if the agent identifies the current fare categories for the adult, three-year-old and ten-year-old, the ten-year-old's required payment product, pram charges and two boarding conditions for accessible buses from the observed guidance. Full credit if the website is inaccessible/blocked and the agent clearly reports this. Partial credit if some elements are missing or incorrect based on available information.

items.criterion: Resolve Scenario V1 (Vancouver TransLink Transfers and Arithmetic)
items.description: Evaluate the agent's resolution of Scenario V1. Full credit if the agent compares the observed cash-bus-then-one-zone-SkyTrain rules with the observed Adult Compass Stored Value rules for a 45-minute interval, and accurately calculates both totals in CAD. Full credit if the website is inaccessible/blocked and the agent clearly reports this. Partial credit if calculations or transfer rules are inaccurate.

items.criterion: Resolve Scenario V2 (Vancouver TransLink Accessibility and Rules)
items.description: Evaluate the agent's resolution of Scenario V2. Full credit if the agent compares the 120-by-60-cm wheelchair and 250-kg combined weight against the observed bus limits, states the observed fare rule for an accompanying 12-year-old and gives two remaining access conditions. Full credit if the website is inaccessible/blocked and the agent clearly reports this. Partial credit if some rules or limits are incorrect.

items.criterion: Resolve Scenario T1 (Toronto TTC Transfer Arithmetic)
items.description: Evaluate the agent's resolution of Scenario T1. Full credit if the agent uses the observed current TTC transfer rules to calculate the total for taps at minutes 0, 70 and 119 and separately for a final tap at minute 121, with both totals in CAD. Full credit if the website is inaccessible/blocked and the agent clearly reports this. Partial credit if the transfer logic or calculations are flawed.

items.criterion: Resolve Scenario T2 (Toronto TTC Youth Rules and Arithmetic)
items.description: Evaluate the agent's resolution of Scenario T2. Full credit if the agent calculates the current totals for an adult plus children aged 12 and 14 for both the older child's credit-card payment and youth PRESTO payment, using the observed fare rules. Must also state the own-card rule as documented, distinguishing paying riders from children who qualify for free travel. Full credit if the website is inaccessible/blocked and the agent clearly reports this. Partial credit if calculations or rules are missing.

items.criterion: Format and Synthesis (Citations, Differences, and Scope)
items.description: Evaluate the agent's output formatting. Full credit if the agent provides exactly six cited rows with arithmetic/rules/conditions (or reports of site limitations), followed by three valid cross-system transfer/payment differences, includes the research date, and retains local currencies (AUD, CAD). Partial credit if the structure is not followed, citations are missing, or cross-system differences are omitted/invalid.
